Our Mission

CG Oncology is a late-stage clinical biopharmaceutical company focused on developing and commercializing a potential backbone bladder-sparing therapeutic for patients afflicted with bladder cancer. We see a world where urologic cancer patients can benefit from our innovative immunotherapies to live with dignity and have an enhanced quality of life.
